description: This file contains functions for rendering text glyphs and generating a PNG image with a 'CAT' label and a nonce, including glyph definitions, drawing functions, and PNG encoding.

methods.name: drawGlyph5x7
methods.description: Draws a 5x7 pixel glyph onto a buffer with scaling and color options.

methods.name: drawText
methods.description: Draws a string of text onto a buffer by rendering individual glyphs.

methods.name: measureTextWidthPx
methods.description: Calculates the width in pixels of a text string at a given scale.

methods.name: renderCatNoncePngBase64
methods.description: Generates a PNG image as a base64 string with 'CAT' label and a nonce, using custom glyph rendering.
